Monsoon Rainfall Expected to Improve in July

The Indian government is expecting monsoon rainfall to improve in July, which could boost kharif crop sowing. This improvement is attributed to the onset of the southwest monsoon, which typically starts in June and lasts until September. The government has set a target for 100% kharif crop sowing, with the aim of increasing agricultural production. However, the current rainfall deficit remains a concern, with some districts still facing water scarcity issues.
